title: Shopify Growth & Operations Manager — DTC Brand (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Marie Originals — a US-based DTC e-commerce brand — needs an OWNER for our Shopify store. Products go out of stock without anyone noticing. Sales drop and no one investigates. This role exists to take full ownership of our Shopify channel and grow it from there.



THIS IS NOT A DEVELOPER ROLE. Shopify has moved past needing heavy coding. This is an account and ecosystem management role — you run the business of the store, not the code behind it.



What you'll own:



Revenue and Growth

- Daily monitoring of sales performance and proactively flagging anomalies (out-of-stock, pricing, broken listings)

- Coordinating promotional strategy and pricing

- Supporting retargeting strategies with our
 and paid ads teams using Shopify customer data

- Optimizing product listings for conversion (pricing, copy, imagery, page structure)



Marketing Coordination

- Coordinating with the paid media team on landing pages and campaigns (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok)

- Setting up and managing SEO apps within Shopify

- Supporting
 retargeting flows using Shopify customer data



Store Operations

- Owning the full Shopify admin: listings, collections, inventory sync, pricing, order flow

- Ensuring no product goes out of stock without a flag and a plan

- Managing end-to-end product launches in Shopify

- Maintaining store health: page speed, mobile, uptime, listing accuracy



Integrations and Ecosystem

- Owning the Shopify app stack: install, configure, audit, troubleshoot

- Managing integrations with ShipStation, Zoho Inventory, and others

- Identifying gaps in the app ecosystem and proposing solutions



What this role is NOT:

- Not a Shopify developer (custom Liquid coding is not the focus)

- Not a graphic designer (the design team handles creative)

- Not a PPC manager (the paid media team owns ads)



Must-haves:

- 2+ years hands-on Shopify store management (full ownership preferred)

- Revenue accountability — you've managed a store with measurable sales targets

- Strong listing optimization: pricing, copy, SEO basics, inventory

- Independent experience managing Shopify app integrations

- Can read Shopify Analytics and act on the data without hand-holding



Strong advantages:

- Coordinating with paid media teams (Meta, Google, TikTok)

-
 retargeting flows using Shopify customer data

- Multi-channel brand experience (Amazon, TikTok Shop, marketplaces + DTC)



90-day milestones:

- Week 1: Full store audit — listings, inventory, integrations, pricing

- Week 4: Weekly sales report format established

- Day 60: First retargeting
 campaign supported with Shopify data

- Day 90: Shopify channel revenue trending up vs. prior 90 days

- USD $1,200-$2,000/month (negotiable)

- Long-term role with direct comms to founders

 marketing - design and layout for landlord-focused campaigns

title: Microsoft 365 Solutions Specialist (SharePoint, Teams & Governance)
description:
*KINDLY READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION & THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.*



About the Organization 



EJF Real Estate Services and The Nabo Group are growing organizations focused on real estate investment and property/HOA management across multiple regions. Our operations rely heavily on structured document management, secure collaboration, and scalable systems to support property portfolios, boards, and internal teams. 



We are undergoing a transformation to modernize and standardize our Microsoft 365 environment, with a strong focus on SharePoint Online, governance, and operational efficiency. 



Overview 



We are seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Solutions Specialist (SharePoint, Teams & Governance) to design and implement a scalable, secure, and governance-driven collaboration environment tailored to a multi-entity real estate and property management organization within the Corporate IT Department. 



This role will focus on building a structured and standardized environment across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and Microsoft Entra ID, enabling efficient document management, controlled access, and future-ready AI and automation capabilities. 



The ideal candidate is a strategic architect, not just an administrator, with experience designing environments that support distributed teams, regional operations, and complex permission models.



Duties & Responsibilities:



Architecture & Design:

 

•  Design enterprise-grade SharePoint Online architecture aligned to:  

 -  Properties / communities (HOAs)  

 -  Regions / portfolios  

 -  Internal departments (Finance, Operations, Legal, etc.)  

•  Implement a hub-and-spoke model with clear hierarchy and navigation  

•  Define scalable information architecture:  

 -  Metadata vs folder structures  

 -  Content types and taxonomy  

 -  Standardized document libraries  

•  Establish site provisioning models and templates for repeatable property onboarding  

•  Align SharePoint with Microsoft Teams and OneDrive usage patterns  



Governance & Compliance:

 

•  Develop and document a SharePoint governance framework tailored to property management operations:  

 -  Naming conventions (properties, regions, departments)  

 -  Site lifecycle management (onboarding/offboarding properties)  

 -  Permission models (board members, internal staff, vendors)

title: Hiring Senior Dispute/Chargeback Manager (Fashion Dropshipping) – Own Risk + Recovery at Scales
description:
We run multiple fast-growing e-commerce fashion stores in the US market, powered primarily by Google Ads. We generated multiple 7 figures in revenue in 2025, and we are building a long-term operation with strong systems, high customer satisfaction, and clean processing metrics.



Disputes and chargebacks are a core lever in our business. They impact profitability, payment approvals, and our ability to scale. We are looking for a Senior Dispute/Chargeback Manager who can take full ownership of dispute operations and build a prevention system that keeps our chargeback rate low as volume grows.



Role Overview



You will own the dispute and chargeback function end-to-end across our stores. Your job is to reduce disputes, win more cases, and prevent chargebacks by improving processes across support, shipping communication, and documentation.



This is not a basic CS role. We want an operator who knows how to manage dispute pipelines, evidence packs, deadlines, win-rate optimization, and root-cause fixes.



What You’ll Do:



Take full ownership of disputes/chargebacks across all stores and processors (Mainly Shopify Payments but future PayPal, etc.)

Monitor daily chargebacks/dispute queues, deadlines, outcomes, and processing risk metrics

D
 what to fight vs refund vs settle early (based on reason codes, evidence strength, and cost/risk)

Build strong, consistent evidence packs (tracking proof, customer comms, policies, product page proof, fraud indicators)



Improve dispute win rate by creating templates, checklists, and SOPs for each dispute type

Implement chargeback prevention systems:

reduce “item not received” disputes with tracking and proactive comms

reduce “not as described” disputes by improving product expectations, sizing clarity, PDP claims

reduce “fraud” disputes with risk filtering rules and order verification triggers



Work closely with Customer Support and Fulfillment to fix the root causes (shipping delays, missing tracking, unclear policies, weak documentation)



Maintain a clean internal “chargeback knowledge base” (reason code playbooks, best evidence by processor, common pitfalls)



Deliver weekly reporting:

dispute rate, chargeback rate, win rate, fee totals, refunds, top drivers

top disputed products/angles, what changed, what needs action next



Requirements (Must Have)

• Proven experience managing disputes/chargebacks for high-volume e-commerce fashion dropshipping stores

• Strong understanding of dispute reason codes (Fraud, INR, Not as Described, Cancelled/Returned, etc.)

• Experience with Shopify Payments/Stripe and PayPal disputes (and how evidence differs)

• Excellent written English and professional documentation skills

• Highly organized: can manage deadlines, queues, evidence archives, and reporting

• Can operate independently and improve systems without being micromanaged



Nice to Have

• Experience in fashion/apparel dropshipping

• Experience supporting Google Ads stores (high intent, higher volume swings)

• Familiarity with chargeback tools/platforms (Chargeflow, Midigator, Disputifier, etc.)

• Experience creating risk rules for fraud prevention and order screening

• Experience building workflows/macros that reduce disputes in helpdesks like Gorgias/Commslayer



Why Join Us

• Real ownership and decision-making power in a critical function

• High growth environment with long-term vision and serious execution

• Opportunity to build a real system and grow into broader Risk/Ops leadership

• We treat the team with respect and reward strong performance, + we're fun and love working together!



To Apply (Important)

1. Send your resume + a short summary of your dispute/chargeback experience (monthly volume, win rate, platforms used).

2. Include the word "WINNER" at the start of your message so we can filter applicants quickly.

3. (Optional but preferred) Share a brief outline of what you would do in your first 14 days to reduce disputes in a Google Ads fashion dropshipping store.



Excited to hear from you. Thank you.

mber

title: Video Editor (Part-Time - Ecomm Paid Ads Focus)
description:
Hours: 5-10h/week (~20-40h/month)

Location: Remote

Start: Immediate



About Lush Protein

Lush Protein is a clean-formulation sports nutrition brand based in Singapore. We sell protein, collagen, and supplements across Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and Australia. Our positioning is simple: no fillers, no fluff - just clean products that work.



We're a lean operation and we move fast. We need someone who can take raw footage and photos and turn them into polished assets that perform, primarily for paid Meta ads 
/Instagram).



What You'll Be Doing

• Editing short-form video clips (15–30 sec) into paid ad creatives for Meta

• Adding captions, text overlays, motion graphics, and product callouts

• Basic colour grading and audio sync

• Resizing and reformatting assets for different placements (Stories, Feed, Reels: 1:1, 9:16, 16:9)

• Light retouching of product photos when needed

• Organising and labelling deliverables clearly for easy version tracking



Expected Output

At 5h/week (20h/month), the expected deliverable target is:



Creatives/month

~16 video ad creatives per month (4 per week average)

Time per creative (approx)

~70 min (edit + format variants + 1 revision round)

Turnaround

2–3 business days per brief

Revision rounds

1 round included per asset



What We're Looking For

• Strong portfolio of short-form video edits — paid social ad examples are a big plus

• Understands hook-first structure: the first 3 seconds must stop the scroll

• Comfortable with text overlays, captions, and simple motion graphics

• Has worked with a product brand before (supplements, food/bev, lifestyle, or beauty all count)

• Fast turnaround — briefs will be clear, we need clean delivery within agreed timelines

• Clear communicator in English — briefs are in English, flag questions early

• Self-directed: you follow a brief and deliver without hand-holding



Tools: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. Photoshop or Canva. Tell us what you use.



What This Is Not

• This is not a purely aesthetic/lifestyle role — we care about performance. Edits must be built around clear hooks, readable overlays, and strong CTAs

• This is not a one-off project — we want someone to grow with us as we scale hours and shoot frequency



To Apply

Please send the following — applications without portfolio examples will not be reviewed:



• 2–3 examples of paid ad or short-form video edits you've done (links or files)

• One example of a product brand you've worked with and what you edited for them

• Tools you use for editing and static asset creation

• Your hourly rate in PHP

• One sentence on why the first 3 seconds of a video ad matter

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?



Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™



We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.



At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.



Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.



What You Will Be Responsible For:

• Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages

• Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences

• Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience

• Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance

• Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion

• Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd

• Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage

• Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams



What We Are Looking For:

• 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.

• A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed.

• Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.

• Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.

• Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.

• Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.

• Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus



Success Roadmap:



In 30 Days, You'll:

• Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.

• Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.

• Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.

• Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.



In 60 Days, You'll:

• Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.

• Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.

• Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.

• Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process



In 90 Days, You'll:

• Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design

• Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.

• Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.

• Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.

 

By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

• Faster landing page creation and iteration

• Higher-quality post-click experiences

• Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure

• A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click



Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

As part of our commitment to food safety, quality and operational excellence, we are seeking a dedicated and experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Officer to join our growing team.

The successful candidate will ensure compliance with HACCP requirements, food safety regulations, customer standards and internal quality procedures across warehousing, transportation and distribution operations.

Food Safety and HACCP

- Conduct hazard analysis and risk assessments.

- Ensure compliance with food safety regulations and customer requirements.

- Maintain food safety records and documentation.

- Lead food safety improvement initiatives.

- Liaise with regulatory authorities when required.

- Monitor compliance with HACCP, GMP and relevant standards.

- Conduct routine inspections of warehouse facilities.

Training and Development

- Conduct food safety and quality training for employees 

- Promote food safety awareness across all departments 

- Support operational teams in implementing best practices 



Supplier and Customer Quality Managements 

- Assist in supplier evaluations and audits 

- Manage customer quality-related inquiries and complaints 

- Support customer quality assurance requirements, particularly within mining, catering and hospitality sectors.

Supply Chain Management or related field.

logistics or cold chain operations.

- Experience in developing and maintaining quality management systems.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.



Preferred Qualifications:

- Strong attention to detail.

- Excellent problem-solving skills.

-  Strong organizational and documentation skills.

- Ability to work independently and under pressure.

- Effective communication and training skills.

title: Operations & Growth VA — Serviced Accommodation Business — 21 Hours/Week
description:
Role: Operations & Growth Virtual Assistant

Business: QP Stays

Location: Remote

Hours: 21 hours per week to start — 3 hours per day

Schedule: Daily check-ins required, including weekends

Rate: To be discussed based on experience

Start date: ASAP



Important — Independent Thinking Required



This role is best suited to someone who already has experience in guest support, serviced accommodation, short-term rentals, hotel operations, property management, or a similar operational role.



I work full-time alongside running the business, so I will not always be available to walk through every small task in real time. There will be clear SOPs, checklists and escalation rules, but I need someone who can think for themselves, prioritise tasks, solve simple problems, and make sensible decisions within agreed boundaries.



This role is not suitable for someone who needs step-by-step instruction for every small task.



I’m looking for someone reliable, proactive, organised, and experienced enough to keep basic daily operations moving even if I am unavailable for a few hours or a day.



You must know when to act, when to log information, and when to escalate.



About QP Stays



QP Stays is a growing serviced accommodation business based in Coventry, UK. We manage properties across Airbnb, 
, VRBO and direct bookings, mainly serving contractors, business travellers, relocation guests, families and longer-stay guests.



We are looking for a reliable, organised and proactive Operations & Growth VA to help with the day-to-day running of the business, guest communication, admin, lead generation, and light social media support.



This is not a basic admin-only role. You must be comfortable dealing with guest messages, check-in issues, cleaning coordination, maintenance updates, booking admin, daily operational checks and outreach.



The right person will be calm, organised, reliable, confident with systems, and able to think clearly when problems happen.



Main Responsibilities



Guest Operations



Monitor guest messages across Airbnb, 
, VRBO and direct bookings

Respond to guest enquiries using approved templates and SOPs

Support pre-arrival checks and online check-in completion

Chase incomplete guest check-in forms when required

Help resolve basic guest issues calmly and professionally

Escalate urgent issues, complaints, damages, refund requests or anything unusual

Monitor guest reviews and flag negative feedback before responding



Cleaning & Property Operations



Check cleaning schedules and completion updates

Monitor Turno cleaning updates and cleaner notes

Flag cleaning issues, missing items, restocking needs or maintenance problems

Help keep property records updated

Log maintenance issues clearly with photos, notes and status updates

Coordinate basic maintenance follow-ups where required



Admin & Systems



Keep Airtable records updated

Update booking, maintenance, expense and lead records

Organise Gmail, Google Drive and property documents

Track daily tasks and provide updates

Help maintain simple operations dashboards

Follow SOPs and checklists accurately



Lead Generation & Outreach



Research local companies in Coventry, Warwickshire and surrounding areas that may need accommodation

Find contacts at construction companies, contractor firms, relocation agencies, insurance companies, healthcare providers, universities and local businesses

Build and update lead lists in Airtable or spreadsheets

Send approved outreach messages

Track replies and follow-ups

Help book calls or viewings for interested leads

Keep lead records organised with contact status and next follow-up dates



Marketing & Social Media Support



This is a bonus part of the role, not the main focus.



The VA may also help with:



Organising property photos and videos in Google Drive

Creating simple Canva graphics

Drafting captions

Scheduling social media posts

Recycling existing content into new posts

Creating review/testimonial posts

Maintaining a simple weekly content calendar

Helping reduce reliance on external social media support over time



Experience with Canva, Meta Business Suite, Instagram,
, TikTok or scheduling tools is a bonus.



Tools We Use



Training will be provided, but you must be comfortable learning new systems.



Uplisting — bookings, messaging, calendar and channel management

SuiteOp — online guest check-in and ID verification

Turno — cleaning scheduling and cleaner updates

Airtable — bookings, maintenance, expenses, leads and operations tracking

Google Workspace — Gmail, Drive, Docs and Sheets

Slack — internal communication

WhatsApp — communication where required

PriceLabs — dynamic pricing, read-only unless instructed



You do not need experience with every tool, but experience with Airbnb, 
, Turno, Airtable, Slack or any property management system is a strong advantage.



What You Will Not Be Responsible For



You will not approve or action the following without permission:



Refunds

Guest compensation

Pricing changes

Booking cancellations

Contractor jobs over £150

Banking or financial transactions

Legal matters

Investor communication

Major guest complaints

Damage claims without approval



If unsure, you must escalate.



What We Are Looking For



Essential



Excellent written English

Reliable daily availability

Strong guest/customer communication skills

Good organisation and attention to detail

Ability to follow SOPs and checklists

Comfortable working independently

Calm and practical when problems happen

Able to prioritise urgent guest issues

Comfortable with weekend check-ins

Confident using online tools and learning new systems

Able to communicate naturally on video calls without reading from AI or scripts



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is preferred:



Airbnb



VRBO

Short-term rentals

Serviced accommodation

Hotel reception or guest support

Property management

Cleaner coordination

Maintenance coordination

Lead generation

 outreach

LinkedIn prospecting

Appointment setting

Canva or social media scheduling



Working Hours



This role starts at 21 hours per week.



The starting structure is 3 hours per day, 7 days per week.



You do not need to be online all day, but you must be available for agreed daily check-ins and responsive during agreed working windows.



Weekend availability is required, mainly for light check-ins, guest issues, cleaning updates and urgent escalations.



The role may grow over time as QP Stays expands.



Ideal Candidate



You will be a good fit if you:



Are reliable and show up when agreed

Communicate clearly and proactively

Like working from systems and checklists

Can handle guest issues calmly

Know when to escalate instead of guessing

Can manage small daily tasks without being chased

Are comfortable doing both operations and growth tasks

Want to grow with a small but ambitious property business



Application Instructions



To apply, please send:



A short cover note explaining your relevant experience

Your CV or resume

A list of tools you have used before

Your weekly availability in UK time

Your expected hourly rate

Any experience you have with lead generation, outreach, social media or Canva

Confirmation that you are comfortable with short weekend check-ins



Important Recruitment Note



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid trial task and video interview.



During the interview, you will be asked live guest scenario questions. Please do not use AI, scripts or prepared notes during the live interview. I use AI myself and have no issue with it for written support, but this role requires real-time guest judgement, natural communication and the ability to think clearly under pressure.



About the Trial Period



The role will begin with a paid trial period.



During the trial, access will be limited and responsibilities will be introduced gradually. The first focus will be guest communication, daily checks, cleaning coordination, Airtable updates and learning the QP Stays systems.



If the trial goes well, the role can expand into more lead generation, outreach, reporting and marketing support.

title: Espesyalista sa Pag-promote ng Turismo sa Pilipinas
description:
Bersyon sa Filipino

Posisyon

Espesyalista sa Pag-promote ng Turismo sa Pilipinas

Lokasyon ng Trabaho

Lokasyon ng Trabaho: Maynila, Pilipinas (Pwedeng magtrabaho mula sa bahay o opisina, napag-uusapan) — kinakailangang nasa Maynila ang empleyado.

Oras ng Trabaho

9:00 umaga - 6:00 hapon, 1 oras na pahinga sa tanghalian, 2 araw na pahinga bawat linggo

Mga Tungkulin sa Trabaho

1.Buong pananagutan sa pakikipag-ugnayan sa mga lokal na ahensya sa paglalakbay at institusyong panturismo sa Pilipinas, gumawa ng pang-araw-araw na komunikasyon sa negosyo at negosasyon, iparating nang mahusay ang mga bentahe ng mga produktong panturismo ng Tsina ng aming kumpanya at mga patakaran sa pakikipagtulungan, at itaguyod ang malalim na pakikipagtulungan sa pagitan ng dalawang panig.

2.Panatilihin ang mga umiiral na mapagkukunan ng ahensya sa paglalakbay na nakikipagtulungan, tumugon kaagad sa mga pangangailangan sa pakikipagtulungan at lutasin ang mga problema sa negosyo, sundan ang pagpapatupad ng pakikipagtulungan, tiyakin ang maayos na pagpapatuloy ng pakikipagtulungan, at palawakin ang mga matatag na pangmatagalang channel sa pakikipagtulungan sa lokal na turismo.

3.Tumulong sa pagkolekta ng impormasyon tungkol sa lokal na merkado ng turismo sa Pilipinas, mga pangangailangan ng mga turista at mga kilos ng mga katunggali, ayusin at ibalik ang impormasyon sa koponan sa loob ng bansa upang makatulong na mapabuti ang mga produktong panturismo at mga plano sa promosyon.

4.Tumulong sa cross-border na koordinasyon ng negosyo, pag-synchronize ng impormasyon at iba pang kaugnay na pantulong na gawain upang tiyakin ang walang hadlang na komunikasyon sa negosyo sa pagitan ng Tsina at Pilipinas, at tumugon kaagad at aktibo sa lahat ng komunikasyon sa trabaho.

Mga Kinakailangan sa Trabaho

1.Katutubong nagsasalita ng Filipino, bihasa sa Ingles (pakikinig, pagsasalita, pagbabasa at pagsusulat), kayang gumawa ng walang hadlang na komunikasyon sa trabaho, pagsusulat ng teksto at pasalitang negosasyon; Ingles ang pang-araw-araw na wika sa trabaho.

2.Pamilyar sa lokal na merkado ng turismo sa Pilipinas, sa paraan ng pagpapatakbo ng mga lokal na ahensya sa paglalakbay at mga kagustuhan sa paglalakbay ng mga turista; mas gusto ang mga aplikanteng may kaugnay na karanasan sa industriya ng turismo o koordinasyon ng negosyo.

3.May mahusay na kasanayan sa komunikasyon, negosasyon sa negosyo at pagpapanatili ng kostumer, proactive at responsable, may malakas na kakayahang magpatupad, kayang magsulong ng pagpapatupad ng negosyo nang mag-isa.

4.May pangunahing kakayahan sa pagsusulat ng teksto at pag-edit ng nilalaman, kayang mabilis na gumawa ng mga materyal sa promosyon ng turismo, at bihasa sa pangunahing operasyon ng software ng opisina.

5.Maingat at mahigpit sa trabaho, may malakas na kamalayan sa cross-cultural na komunikasyon, mataas na pakiramdam ng responsibilidad at mabuting espiritu ng koponan.

Suweldo at Mga Benepisyo

Batayang Suweldo: 30,000 Peso bawat buwan

title: Executive Assistant to the COO
description:
What We Offer

- Starting salary of $1,300+/month USD, with room to grow based on demonstrated experience and judgment

- Direct working relationship with the COO of a fast-scaling creator agency; you'll see how senior decisions actually get made

- A role where you're trusted, not micromanaged, trained early, then given your lane to run

- Daily exposure to AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) used at a professional level

- 100% remote, Philippines-based, full-time (8 hrs/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours

- A genuine career-defining seat for an experienced EA, close to the executive table, broad exposure across the business



The Role

Be the Second Brain to a Senior Executive at a Fast-Growing Creator Agency | $1,300+/month | 100% Remote, Philippines. 



The COO of this agency is at capacity. He's currently doing all of it himself -- updating trackers, chasing people, drafting documents, building workflows, managing calendar conflicts, thinking through hard conversations alone. Every hour spent on that is an hour not spent on the work only a COO can do. This is the role that fixes that.



We're hiring an Executive Assistant who can absorb the COO's recurring admin and execution load, at high volume, at speed, and to a standard he can trust without checking. You'll own the doing so he can own the d
. This is not a hand-holding role. You'll be trained early, then trusted to run your lane.



The right person for this seat doesn't wait to be told the next step. They take the brief and run. They see the work that needs doing before being asked. And they're the kind of operator a COO can hand something off to and consider it handled.





What You'll Own

- Project and tracker management. Keep all the COO's project trackers and statuses current in Airtable. Maintain visibility on what's moving, what's stuck, and what's due. Nothing falls through.

- Follow-ups and chasing. Own the follow-up loop end-to-end. Chase outstanding items, send the reminders, surface blockers to the COO before they become problems.

- Document drafting. Draft documents the COO would otherwise write himself; to a standard he can route straight for approval without rewriting.

- Workflow builds in ProcessStreet. Build straightforward, repeatable workflows so the COO doesn't have to. Examples: one-off task workflows, leave handoff workflows where leave isn't approved until a handoff plan is filled out and routed.

- Process builds for capacity-constrained department heads. When a department head is buried, build their process for them under the COO's direction. Example: standing up a hiring or onboarding workflow when the owner is buried in interviews.

- Calendar and scheduling. Manage the COO's calendar, resolve meeting overlaps, find times that work across multiple people's schedules.

- Thinking partner. Act as a sounding board on draining or tricky calls. Offer a different angle on how to approach a hard conversation. Handle the legwork of putting things into Claude for the COO.





What You Bring:

Experience (non-negotiable)

- Prior experience as an EA to a senior executive. We want someone who already understands the cadence of supporting an exec at this level; not someone learning it for the first time.

- Comfortable operating at pace across many small parallel tasks. This role is high-volume throughput, not deep specialist work.

Skills (must-have)

- Project and tracker management, hands-on with Airtable

- Strong follow-up discipline; you don't need to be told twice

- Document drafting to a standard a senior executive can route without edits

- ProcessStreet workflow building from a brief

- Calendar management across multiple people's schedules

- Proficient in Claude and AI tools as part of your daily workflow

- Native English



Personality and culture fit (non-negotiable)

- Self-starter. Takes the brief and runs.

- A useful second brain: Offers a different perspective on how to approach a tricky conversation, not just executes the task

- Discreet and trustworthy. You'll see contracts, compensation conversations, and sensitive internal decisions

- Reliable enough that the COO can hand something off and consider it done





Location & Hours

100% remote, based in the Philippines. 

Full-time (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours.



How You'll Be Measured

- This role is measured on how much load it reliably takes off the COO and how cleanly the work gets done. Specific KPIs and targets are set quarterly with the COO, but the core measures are:

- Task turnaround — speed and reliability on items the COO hands off

- Tracker accuracy and freshness — project trackers stay current, accurate, and trusted as a single source of truth

- Follow-up completion — outstanding items chased to closure, blockers surfaced early

- COO time reclaimed — the headline outcome. How much of the COO's week is freed from admin back into strategic work.



Hiring Process

Application ? screening call with the People team ? working interview with the COO ? final decision. We move quickly: strong candidates typically receive offers within 10 days of first contact.

title: Pre-Visit Chart Preparation Specialist
description:

If you have not prepared patient charts prior to visits (including verifying referrals, authorizations, and benefits), please do not apply.

This role is heavily focused on ensuring patient charts are fully prepared, verified, and complete prior to visits, including referrals, authorizations, benefits, and documentation. Candidates must have hands-on experience in chart prep workflows within a U.S. healthcare setting.







Required Experience (Applicants without this will not be considered):



Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on chart preparation experience in a U.S. medical practice

Proven experience preparing charts prior to patient intake (not just data entry or scheduling)





Experience verifying:



Referrals and authorizations

Insurance eligibility and benefits

PCP assignment and coordination of benefits

Experience using payer portals such as Availity, UHC, Tricare, Cigna, etc.

Ability to interpret and communicate patient financial responsibility before visits









Core Responsibility: Pre-Visit Chart Preparation (Primary Focus)



Prepare and audit patient charts 24–48 hours prior to appointments

Ensure completeness of:

Demographics

Active insurance

PCP assignment

Referrals & authorizations (auth #, validity, visits, POS)

Identify missing or incorrect documentation and resolve proactively

Communicate gaps to patients and clinic staff before visit date

Document all verification steps with reference numbers and notes

Insurance & Benefits Verification (Supporting Chart Prep)



Verify eligibility and benefits using portals and outbound calls

Calculate and communicate patient responsibility using fee schedules

Flag inactive coverage, COB issues, or auth requirements immediately

Coordination & Patient Communication

title: SEO Specialist | Content Driven
description:
## The role in one line



You lead SEO for a small portfolio of clients and own what we deliver to them: strategy, on-page, content and links. You set the direction for each campaign and ensure the work that goes out is genuinely good.



## We are a small agency, and that is the point



We are small on purpose and growing steadily, so read the responsibilities below in that light. You would lead fewer than 10 active campaigns, and they would be small in scope, not sprawling enterprise accounts. We cap how much any one person carries: before the work piles up, we bring in more people to support the other parts of a campaign. You are also free to bring in copywriters and link-building contractors, and to manage them.



So, while the list below may look broad, you are not doing all of it alone or at scale. You lead the campaigns, set the standard, and pull in support where it helps. We also have someone who handles technical SEO, so that is not on your plate day-to-day.



## Who you would be working for



We are part of Lakewood media, a UK agency going since 2013.



We care about more than rankings. The wider mission is to do excellent digital work for purpose-driven businesses while giving something back, including a commitment to plant 1,000 trees by 2027 and a focus on the communities we work in across the UK, the Philippines and South Africa. We are aiming to become one of the top premium UK digital agencies, and we want the people who help get us there to grow with us.



## How we work, and why you would want to



We are a small, distributed team, and we are genuinely flexible.



- Work the hours that suit you. Your working day is largely yours to shape.

- Your location does not matter to us. Work from wherever you are.

- The only fixed ask is that you are available for the handful of meetings we schedule.

- We judge the work by its outputs, not by hours logged.

- You would be part of a small team where your opinion, expertise and time are genuinely valued.



## What makes this role different



Most of our current work sits inside one niche: high-end adult brands, specifically escort agencies. This is under our agency HauteLab. You will start there, across our full client roster, and learn that world by working in it.



Within roughly the next 6-12 months, you will also take on clients for our sister brand, Peak Narrative, which operates in very different sectors: education, the environment, and outdoor lifestyle. The delivery model is the same. The niches are not.



That is why we care far more about strong, current SEO fundamentals than about niche experience. Good SEO works in any niche. We can quickly hand you the context for a sector, we cannot teach sound judgment as quickly. If you understand why something ranks, you will be effective whether the page is about an escort agency or a private school.



## What you will own



- Lead every SEO campaign in your portfolio: set the strategy, priorities and roadmap, and keep each one moving

- Own the deliverables. You build the monthly deliverable reports and bring them to Adam, who stays the client's primary point of contact and runs the live monthly reviews

- Plan content strategy for each client, oversee content creation (your own and your writers'), and edit to a high standard

- Run link building at the small scale these clients need, bringing in and managing link contractors to help

- Hire and manage copywriters and freelancers where it helps: brief them, review their work, keep them on time and on standard

- Keep the client workbooks accurate and delivery on cadence



## The SEO expertise we need



We want an all-out SEO expert, someone whose judgment we can trust on any campaign. Specifically, deep command of:



- On-page SEO, inside out: titles, headings, internal linking, structured data and content quality, all matched to user intent rather than a word count.

- Content strategy: planning topic clusters and the pieces that actually move rankings, not filler or generic AI nonsense. **We are looking for someone with ‘outside the box’ thinking that can work with clients to build unique content angles.**

- Trust and E-E-A-T as a site-wide signal: about pages, author and trust signals, and non-commodity content that earns its place.

- Current SEO strategy: people-first content as the baseline (the Helpful Content System is now part of core ranking), and a clear-eyed view of AI search. AI Overviews and AI Mode run on the same systems as classic search, so doing real SEO covers both. We do not chase "AEO" or "GEO" gimmicks.

- The value of links and how to build them at small scale: quality over quantity, a real grasp of anchor distribution, velocity and source diversity, and the judgment to win a few strong links rather than many weak ones.

    - Understanding how to us AI tools to during this process is critical. For example using Claude Code to build tailored targets for outreach and push them into a cold outreach campaign on Smartlead.



## Tools and data



- SEO and analytics: strong working mastery of Ahrefs, Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.

- Site audits: you do not have to be our deep technical person, we have someone who handles technical SEO. But when an Ahrefs or Screaming Frog audit flags issues, you need to read it, know which on-page problems matter, and either fix them yourself or direct how they should be fixed.

- AI as a force multiplier: a real part of how we work, covered in its own section below. Deep knowledge of Claude using Cowork, Code and skills.

- Our stack: Asana (project management), Notion (knowledge base), Missive 
 and comms), Pipedrive (sales), Google Workspace and WordPress for sites we build and manage.



## Working with AI (a big part of how we operate)



We lean on AI to keep quality high and delivery efficient, so using it well genuinely matters here. We do test for it, because it is part of the job, not a bolt-on.



We are not looking for someone who pastes a prompt into Claude and copies the answer back out. We want someone who builds AI into the work to lift the quality and the speed of the end result. In practice that means:



- Using Claude on real, multi-step tasks, not one-off questions

- Building repeatable workflows with connectors and skills. For example: pull a Screaming Frog crawl or a GSC via Composio connector, break it down, cross-reference it against Ahrefs, then turn it into a clear, prioritised report a client can read in plain English

- Being able to maintain and use more advanced setups, not just chat. Cowork and Code for long complex tasks. Building skills and updating existing to make processes and workflows more efficient.

- Knowing the line between augmenting your judgment and outsourcing it. AI improves the output; it does not produce the deliverable unsupervised



Done well, this is how one person handles more clients without the quality dropping. It is central to how we operate.



## Attention to detail and organisation (non-negotiable)



You will hold many moving parts across several clients at once: content stages, link logs, reporting deadlines, vendor spend and workbook hygiene. Small errors compound fast across a portfolio. We need someone genuinely meticulous and well organised, who keeps trackers accurate, follows a process and does not let things slip. This is a hard requirement, and the assessment is built to surface whether you have it.



## What a typical week looks like



This is built from the real work the role carries today, not a generic list.



**Content**



- Plan the month's content for each client and brief the freelance writers (when needed)

- Write and edit blog posts, landing pages, city and category pages, and client profile pages

- Review writers' drafts against the brief and our human-first standard before anything goes live



**Links**



- Own each client's link plan, build links at the small scale they need, and use contractors to help with outreach and placements

- Vet and rate links from vendors, find and buy relevant expired domains, and log every live link in the workbook



**Technical and analysis**



- Review Ahrefs and Screaming Frog site audits and turn the findings into a prioritised on-page action list (our technical specialist handles the heavy technical fixes)

- Check Search Console for discovered-but-not-indexed content and track stage keywords in Ahrefs

- Run competitor and link-gap analysis, on-page audits and trust or about-page builds



**Reporting and admin**



- Produce end-of-month deliverables summaries per client and set up the next month's content stages

- Keep workbooks clean (stage IDs, content planner, live links), document decisions in the client wiki, and stay on top of client



## Being upfront about the niche



We specialise in high-end adult brands, specifically escort agencies. We are completely transparent about this from the start, because we know it is not for everyone.



The work itself is standard SEO and content delivery. If you are not comfortable working in this sector, this is not the right role, and that is fine. We would rather you know now than later.



## Who this is for



- A genuine SEO expert who can lead campaigns and own delivery without hand-holding

- Deep on content, on-page, E-E-A-T and links (technical depth is a bonus, not a must, we have that covered)

- Genuinely fluent with AI as a working tool, not a novelty

- Meticulous, organised and reliable on deadlines

- Comfortable in the adult niche, able to flex into other sectors, and keen to grow with us long term



## Who it is not for



- Specialists who only do one slice of SEO and cannot lead a whole campaign

- Anyone who needs a fixed playbook and struggles when the niche changes

- "AI users" whose skill stops at pasting prompts

- Anyone who needs AI to understand the work they are doing.



## Where this role can go



This is not a seat to fill and forget. We are growing, and we want the person we bring in now to grow with us and become a key part of the agency. As we add clients, you would lead a bigger share of delivery and bring people in under you rather than just carry more yourself.



The rate is a starting point, and we expect it to rise as you take on more and as we grow. If you want somewhere to do excellent work and build something over the next few years, this is it.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Built on over four decades of pioneering research at Princeton University, our platform represents the leading edge of innovation in freight and transportation planning. We help customers unlock double-digit revenue gains and drive smarter, data-driven operations at scale.

With the recent close of our Series C funding round led by Koch Disruptive Technologies, we’re entering an exciting new phase of growth. Today, Optimal Dynamics is a high-growth company of ~70 employees, backed by top-tier investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, The Westly Group, Activate Capital, and Koch. 



We're on a mission to redefine the way logistics decisions are made—and we’re just getting started.



About Our Team



We are a team of bright, kind, and solution-oriented people focused on creating value for our customers. We can solve problems individually, but understand that the best solutions are found when the team brainstorms ideas together. We are excited about balancing the need to deploy new solutions quickly and designing solutions that are secured, reliable, maintainable, and scalable for the long run.



About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to lead the 0?1 buildout and 1?n scaling of AI capabilities at Optimal Dynamics. You’ll set direction, establish engineering standards, and deliver production systems that ground AI outputs in trustworthy company and customer data. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership where you’ll make key architecture and tooling choices and evolve them as we learn.



Key Responsibilities:



Own RAG initiatives end-to-end from problem framing and data readiness through prototyping, iteration, and production launch.



Establish foundational components and practices for document processing, indexing, retrieval, orchestration, and evaluation; selecting tools and approaches that balance quality, cost, and speed.



Build reliable services and APIs that are observable, secure, and designed for scale in a cloud environment.



Define success metrics (quality, latency, cost, safety) and drive continuous improvement via experimentation and data-driven decisions.



Create durable team assets (i.e. playbooks, test harnesses, checklists, and documentation) to make RAG development repeatable across products.



Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data/ML, Engineering, and GTM to translate ambiguous needs into shippable capabilities with clear business impact.



Mentor teammates and contribute to a strong engineering culture around AI systems and responsible deployment.

Who You Are

Experienced: a Senior, hands-on engineer who can take a fuzzy problem from discovery to reliable production outcomes.



Pragmatic: You balance quality, cost, speed, and risk to ship value iteratively.



Innovative: Comfortable choosing and evolving the stack as needs change; you create guardrails and standards along the way.



Communicative: You have the ability to align stakeholders and translate complex technical ideas into clear decisions.



Operational Owner: You care about reliability, observability, and measurable impact on customers and the business.

Key Qualifications

4+ years of proven industry experience building and operating backend, platform, or data services at production scale 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, or Mathematics/Physics

Proven track record delivering data or ML-powered features end-to-end (Discovery/Prototyping > Launch > Iteration).

Python Proficiency - you write well-tested & maintainable code.

API design expertise and experience with cloud services (preferably AWS)

Familiarity with information retrieval concepts and grounding AI systems in trustworthy data.

Comfort setting technical direction, selecting tools, and establishing engineering best practices for AI-focused builds. 

Nice to Have (Bonus Points)

Experience introducing retrieval-augmented or knowledge-grounded AI capabilities in a product or platform context.

Exposure to evaluation methodologies for AI systems (quality, latency, cost, safety) and running experiments/A-B tests.

Background working with unstructured data pipelines, indexing, and search, whether homegrown or via managed services.

Experience mentoring engineers, uplifting practices, and creating reusable playbooks and templates.

Experience in the transportation, logistics, or broader supply chain industry.

Customer-facing collaboration comfort: gathering requirements, scoping MVPs, and measuring ROI post-launch.

Why Join Us

At Optimal Dynamics, you’ll work with a world-class AI team and industry experts to tackle some of the most complex and impactful challenges in logistics. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a greenfield capability from the ground up—setting strategy, architecture, and standards while seeing your work directly power decisions for leading logistics companies. You’ll thrive in a pragmatic, collaborative culture with tight feedback loops, the autonomy to choose the right tools, and the support to make bold ideas a reality. Along the way, you’ll partner with experienced engineers, data and ML practitioners, and industry experts.



If you’re passionate about building AI products that solve real-world problems, we’d love to hear from you.



Pay Range



$2000 - $2500 USD



Benefits



Competitive compensation, including Series C level equity

description:
About Us



We're a small, established US-owned company with a team based in the Philippines, hiring through OnlineJobs.ph for over a decade. To do that, we need to keep finding new business ideas worth building — and we use AI as a thinking partner to do it.

Background in business, research, marketing, or finance

title: Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator
description:
About Alpha Key Digital

Alpha Key Digital is a digital marketing agency specializing in patient acquisition for cosmetic surgeons, dermatologists, medical spas, and cosmetic dentists. We’ve been in business for 10 years, serve 12 retainer clients, and are growing. We’re a small team that operates with precision. No bloat. No unnecessary meetings. Clear communication, clean systems, and work that gets done when it’s supposed to get done.

We are looking for a Virtual Assistant to take operational, administrative, and coordination tasks off the founder’s plate so he can focus on client strategy, business development, and growth. This is a high-trust role. You will be the person who keeps the engine running behind the scenes.

The Role: Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator. Full-time. Remote. Must have significant overlap with US Eastern business hours.

You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. The founder runs the client relationships and the strategy. You run the operational backbone that supports it:
 triage, project management, scheduling, contractor coordination, content posting, and prospect list management. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you close it.

This is not a customer-facing role. You will not be talking to clients directly. You will be the person behind the curtain making sure every deliverable, every
, every task, and every calendar event is where it’s supposed to be so the founder can walk into any conversation fully prepared.

You’d Be a Great Fit If You Are

The person who builds the checklist before anyone asks for one. You organize by instinct, not because someone gave you a system to follow. You create the system.

Reliable to the point where people stop checking your work because they already know it’s done. You don’t need reminders. You are the reminder.

Someone who reads the full
 before responding. You catch the detail in the third paragraph that everyone else misses. You ask the clarifying question before it becomes a problem.

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision. You don’t need daily check-ins to stay productive. You need clear expectations and then space to execute.

Proactive about surfacing problems early. If something is off, you flag it immediately instead of hoping it resolves itself. You know the difference between handling it yourself and escalating it.

Disciplined with time. You batch similar work together. You don’t context-switch 15 times a day. When you’re in a task, you finish it before moving on.

Protective of other people’s calendars. You treat the founder’s schedule like a strategic asset, not a suggestion. If something doesn’t belong on the calendar, you say so.

Someone who takes pride in clean systems. Your Asana is current. Your inbox is processed. Your files are named correctly. You don’t leave loose ends.

What You Actually Do


 and Communication Management

Triage the founder’s inbox daily. Flag urgent items, draft responses for routine
s, archive what doesn’t need attention.

Manage Slack communication with the white-label development team (E2M) and contractors. Relay updates, follow up on late deliverables, keep threads organized.

Ensure no
 or message sits unanswered for more than 24 hours during business days.

Project Management and Task Coordination

Own Asana: create tasks from briefs, assign to the right team member, track deadlines, follow up on overdue items, and keep the board clean.

Coordinate deliverables between the founder, PPC contractor, SEO team, and E2M web development team. You are the traffic controller.

Run a weekly check on all active client projects to confirm nothing is behind schedule. Surface delays to the founder before the client notices.

Calendar and Scheduling

Manage the founder’s calendar. Schedule client meetings, prospect calls, internal huddles, and personal appointments.

Protect time blocks. The founder has dedicated strategic work time that should not be interrupted by meetings. You enforce that.

Confirm and send reminders for all meetings. No missed appointments.

LinkedIn and Prospect List Management

Schedule LinkedIn posts (batch-created by the founder) using a scheduling tool.

Export connection lists from Ulinc (LinkedIn automation tool) and organize prospect data in spreadsheets.

Maintain and clean prospect lists. Tag, sort, and update contact records as the outbound pipeline grows.

Send LinkedIn event invitations to targeted lists for webinars (up to 1,000/week). Copy, paste, send.

Content and Social Media Support

Post pre-approved content to social media channels on schedule. You are not creating the content. You are making sure it goes live when it’s supposed to.

Upload and schedule video content (case studies, testimonials) to appropriate platforms.

Basic Canva edits for social media graphics if needed.

Reporting Support

Pull data from Google Looker Studio dashboards for monthly client reports. You are not analyzing the data. You are making sure the reports are assembled and ready for the founder to review.

Track basic metrics the founder requests (Ulinc connection rates, LinkedIn post engagement,
 open rates).

What You Are Not Doing

Talking to clients. The founder owns all client relationships until a Client Success Manager is hired.

Setting strategy or making campaign decisions. You coordinate. You don’t decide.

Financial work. No bookkeeping, invoicing, or payment processing.

Writing original content, ad copy, or marketing strategy. You post and schedule what others create.

You are the operational backbone that frees the founder to do the work only he can do.

Qualifications

Required

Two or more years of experience as a virtual assistant, operations coordinator, or executive assistant supporting a founder or small team

Proficiency in Asana or a comparable project management tool (ClickUp, Monday, Trello)

Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar)

Proficiency in Slack or a comparable team messaging tool

Strong written English. Clear, professional, no errors.

Reliable internet connection and a quiet, distraction-free workspace

Available during US Eastern business hours (minimum 6 hours of overlap with 8am-5pm ET)

Preferred

Experience supporting a digital marketing agency or a B2B service business

Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and LinkedIn posting/scheduling

Familiarity with Google Looker Studio (pulling reports, not building them)

Experience with Canva for basic graphic edits

Experience with Zapier or Make for workflow automation

Familiarity with CRM tools (GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, or similar)

Experience coordinating with offshore or white-label teams across time zones

Tools You Will Use Daily

, docs, sheets, calendar

Weekly

Compensation and Details

Pay

mbers' work

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. The company is investing in your next step.





How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Senior E-Commerce Bookkeeper – Multiplatform E-Commerce Accounting Specialist
description:
About the Company

The company specialises in high-performance Amazon PPC management, trusted by clients for its precision, insight, and results. With steady organic growth and a small, expert team, this is an exceptional opportunity to grow alongside a company built on quality, not hype.

About the role

We need a Senior bookkeeper with deep, hands-on E-commerce accounting experience, not general bookkeeping with a passing familiarity of online retail. You must understand the layered complexity of multi-platform selling: settlement timing, marketplace fee structures, split inventory pools, returns, and COGS that must track accurately across every channel. You work independently, own your output, and can train an operational team to understand what they're looking at.

Applicants without direct E-commerce inventory bookkeeping experience, COGS recognition, inventory asset management, and multi-platform reconciliation will not be shortlisted. General bookkeeping experience alone does not meet the requirements of this role.



What you'll own

E-commerce & Amazon Accounting Specialist

Multi E-Commerce Platform accounting reconciliation: sales, refunds, FBA/referral/storage fees, sponsored ads, and reimbursements are correctly categorised and posted.

Multi-platform revenue reconciliation: Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Chewy and more, each with its own payout timing, fees, and reporting format reconciled into one accurate GL.

Marketplace tax handling: marketplace facilitator tax flows correctly without inflating revenue.

Ad spend allocation: Amazon PPC and off-platform spend treated correctly as operating expenses, reconciled against actual campaign data.

Inventory bookkeeping & COGS

Inventory as a balance sheet asset: purchase orders posted to inventory, not expensed; landed costs (freight, duties, prep) correctly capitalised.

COGS recognition: accurate cost matched to units sold using FIFO or weighted average as appropriate; no blunt average cost assumptions masking margin.

Multi-location inventory:  FBA fulfilment centres, 3PL warehouses, and owned stock are each correctly reflected on the balance sheets.

Inventory reconciliation: regular reconciliation of system counts against accounting records; variances from shrinkage, damage, returns, and Amazon discrepancies are properly adjusted.

Returns & kitting: correct treatment of resellable vs destroyed returns; component-level COGS allocation for bundled and kitted SKUs.

Agency & internal accounting

Full-cycle bookkeeping: chart of accounts, journal entries, bank feeds, reconciliations, and month-end close.

AP/AR, contractor payments, client invoicing, retainer tracking, and project cost allocation

Clean, audit-ready books at all times; not catch-up dependent





Manager training

Build practical SOPs and train hands-on managers in daily financial workflows, platform navigation, and report interpretation; building real confidence, not dependency

Platform requirements:

Accounting

Xero

QuickBooks Online

QuickBooks Desktop

E-commerce

Amazon Seller Central

Walmart

Chewy

We are a coaching practice working with successful founders, entrepreneurs, and professionals who look like they have it all on the outside but feel privately stuck, unfulfilled, or disconnected from what really matters.

Example of b-roll with text:

This role is ideal for a builder who is comfortable owning execution across frontend, backend integration, and release preparation for a mobile app. We are specifically looking for a developer who already uses AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and similar platforms to accelerate development, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and testing.

Ability to work EST hours 9AM-5PM Eastern Timezone.

Strong experience building and shipping full mobile applications from scratch.

Proven proficiency with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor (main tool), Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar.
